indexLead: Free, quick calculators that answer common questions before you buy.

tv.title: TV size calculator: which screen size for my viewing distance?
tv.lead: Enter how far you sit from the TV. We show the screen size range recommended by cinema standards (30° to 40° viewing angle).
tv.note: With 4K or 8K you can choose the larger end of the range. With Full HD, stay at the smaller end.

projector.title: Projector distance calculator
projector.lead: Enter the throw ratio from the projector's specifications and the image size you want. We show how far the projector must be from the screen.
projector.note: Throw ratio = distance ÷ image width. Projectors with zoom have a range, for example 1.2–1.5: check both values.

ppi.title: Screen sharpness calculator (PPI)
ppi.lead: Enter the resolution and the diagonal. We show pixel density, pixel size and the distance from which single pixels are no longer visible.
ppi.note: Based on normal 20/20 vision. A typical desk distance is 50–80 cm.

powerbank.title: Power bank on a plane: Wh calculator
powerbank.lead: Airlines limit power banks in watt-hours (Wh), but the box usually shows mAh. Enter the capacity to see whether you can take it on board.
powerbank.ok: Allowed in hand luggage (up to 100 Wh). Never in checked baggage.
powerbank.approval: 101–160 Wh: only with the airline's approval, usually up to 2 per passenger, hand luggage only.
powerbank.forbidden: Over 160 Wh: not allowed on passenger planes.
powerbank.note: Based on IATA rules used by most airlines; your airline may be stricter. Use 3.7 V unless the label shows another value.

ac.title: Air conditioner size calculator (kW and BTU)
ac.lead: Enter the room size. We estimate the cooling power you need and show the standard unit sizes that fit.
ac.note: Rule of thumb based on room volume; a kitchen or a room with many people needs about 10–20% more. An installer's heat-load calculation is more precise.

boiler.title: Boiler size calculator: what kW do I need?
boiler.short: Gas boiler size for your home
boiler.lead: Enter the heated area, insulation and number of bathrooms. We estimate the heating load and the combi boiler output you need for hot water.
boiler.baths: Bathrooms with a shower or bath
boiler.note: Hot water usually decides the size of a combi boiler: about 24 kW for one bathroom, 30 kW for two, 35 kW or a system boiler with a cylinder for three or more. Sizing must be confirmed by a registered installer.

household.title: Fridge, washing machine and dishwasher size for your household
household.lead: Enter how many people live at home. We show the fridge volume, washing machine drum size and dishwasher width that usually fit.
household.note: If you cook a lot, freeze food or wash bedding at home, choose the upper end. A fuller drum is more efficient than a large half-empty one.

energy.title: Electricity cost calculator for any appliance
energy.lead: Enter the power in watts and how long the appliance runs. We show the energy use and the cost per month and per year.
energy.note: The default price is the average household tariff in your country including taxes; enter the price from your bill for an exact result. Devices on standby also use power.

size.title: Phone size comparison in real size (calibrated to your screen)
size.lead: See phones, tablets and smartwatches at their true physical size on your screen. Calibrate once with any bank card, then compare models side by side or on top of each other.
size.calText: Hold a bank card (or any ID-1 card: ID, driving licence) against the screen and move the slider until the outline matches the card exactly.
size.calHint: Calibration is saved on this device.
size.approx: ≈ estimated from screen size — exact dimensions not published
size.tip: Tip: put your own phone on the screen to compare it with any model.
size.noData: No size data for this model

wall.title: TV size on your wall: see it in a photo of your room
wall.lead: Take a photo of your wall with an A4 sheet of paper taped to it. Mark the sheet, choose a TV and see exactly how big it will look — to scale.
wall.step1: 1. Tape an A4 sheet (21 × 29.7 cm) to the wall — portrait — and take a photo from where you sit.
wall.step2: 2. Drag the corners of the blue frame onto the edges of the sheet.
wall.step3: 3. Choose a screen size or a model and drag the TV where you want it.
wall.privacy: Your photo stays on your device — it is never uploaded.
